stepExplanation: The coding strand 5'-ATGCCTTACGAA-3' becomes mRNA 5'-AUGCCUUACGAA-3'. After mutation (C to T), the coding strand 5'-ATGCTTTACGAA-3' gives mRNA 5'-AUGCUUUACGAA-3'. The second codon changes from CCU to CUU.
stepBody: First, determine the mRNA sequence for both original and mutated DNA. Which codon is changed by the mutation?
